messages:
Ravi Menon: Heads up— Vellum Labs preview cleared (NDA in place). They want a one-week preview: hardware perf + a short marketplace SKU spec before public listing. Need to coordinate bench runs, security checklist, and a 1-paragraph marketplace blurb.
Elena Garcia: Nice. Proposed success criteria: p95 < 150ms @ 128 tokens on Vellum-XL, sustained 90k tokens/s host-side for batch=16, and no OOMs under seq=4096. Also require passing the privacy checklist.
Tom Becker: I'll take runtime and kernel validation. Vellum nodes report ROCm 5.6 and patched drivers; we'll test rcl-checked kernels + fallback to generic kernels. Will add a short script to validate NUMA + hugepages.
Priya Shah: I'll own benchmarks and eval prompts. Suggest three suites: conversational, code-gen, and long-context summarization. We'll run both deterministic greedy and top-p sampling.
Mateo Ruiz: Ops: network notes — ingesters are behind NAT; need to open outbound for telemetry collector 52.34.12.90:443. Also, we'll capture PSU/power.csv that Vellum will stream. Confirm retention policy before ingest.
LegalBot: Legal: NDA signed. Two outstanding asks from Vellum: (1) telemetry retention length, (2) export control questionnaire. Please route telemetry retention to Legal.
Ravi Menon: Timeline draft: Mon: infra + image push; Tue: bench runs (small iter); Wed: stability sweep + thermal logging; Thu: prepare marketplace SKU & draft blurb; Fri: handoff to partner.
Elena Garcia: Marketplace SKU needs: supported model flavors, recommended kernel/driver, SLO notes, sample pricing tier, and a 1-line security summary. I can draft the security blurb.
Tom Becker: Bench CLI we'll use (inside runtime image):
```
./rv-bench \
  --model vellum-xl-13b \
  --precision fp16 \
  --seq 4096 \
  --batch 16 \
  --iters 200 \
  --telemetry https://telemetry.redwood.ai/ingest \
  --power-file /tmp/psu_stream.csv
```
Priya Shah: Metrics to collect: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, end-to-end CPU usage, GPU mem high-water, thermal spikes, and model output divergence vs our baseline. I'll add a small regression harness to compare generations.
Mateo Ruiz: Firewall updated for 52.34.12.90, tested curl -> 200. Will share audit log after runs.
Ravi Menon: Action items: Tom build image + numactl checks, Mateo whitelist & collect power stream, Priya push eval sets, Elena draft marketplace blurb, Legal finalize retention + export control.
LegalBot: Partner accepted 30-day telemetry retention with hashed traces only; export control form requested by EOD Tue.
Priya Shah: Prompt sets uploaded to /shared/partnerships/vellum-preview/prompts. Running a quick warmup now.
Tom Becker: Runtime image pushed: redwood-runtime:vellum-preview-20260330-rc2. Kernel toggles in /ci/tools/kernel-switch.sh.
ops-bot: job-scheduler: queued bench job vellum-20260330-01 (start=1965087600)
Elena Garcia: Draft blurb for marketplace (first pass): "Vellum-XL on Redwood: high-throughput inference for long-context workloads. Verified configs, driver recommendations, and telemetry integration included." Pls comment.
Ravi Menon: Looks good. Final sync Thu 9am PT to review artifacts before handoff. Drop quick confirmations as you complete tasks. :rocket:
